description: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:618 — LintRunner::with_bundle_version(lints, version: &'static str) forces callers to use compile-time literals. A caller that reads the bundle version from a config file or database cannot use this API without Box::leak. Finding::rule_bundle_version is also &'static str for the same reason. Fix: change bundle_version in LintRunner to Cow<'static, str> (mirroring Finding::lint_id and citation), update with_bundle_version to accept impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>, and change Finding::rule_bundle_version to Cow<'static, str>. This is a minor breaking change but removes the &'static str constraint without losing the zero-copy path for literal strings.
title: LintRunner::with_bundle_version requires &'static str, blocks runtime config
